howToAdd: Append one object to sessions[] per game session or test. Fill server.* from _tools/server-timeline.js --json, clientHealth.* from _tools/client-health-summary.js --json, tcpWatch.* by reading the tcp-watch log. Keep metric names identical; put anything new in notes or a new optional field. Masked /16 routes only — no full IPs in git.

metrics.pageLoads: world-data vends in the window (server log) = page loads
metrics.logins: /join logins; more than 1 = the player went back through the join screen
metrics.reloadSecAfterDraw: per reload: vend time minus the later of (last scene activation, own previous page load). The page load began ~10-50 s before the vend.
metrics.modes: reloadSecAfterDraw buckets: quick <=120 s, mid 121-299, sixMin 300-420, long >420
metrics.pairedReloads: reloads with another watched player's reload <=60 s away
metrics.pageLoadSec: first new TCP connection -> vend (tcp-watch), when captured

Forge edge copies stay fresh ~500 s (Cache-Control max-age=500) and less-used images get evicted soon after: re-requests 12-60 min later were MISS or REVALIDATED.
